Tredzo Development Foundation
(Incorporation)
6.  Subject  to  the  provisions  of  this  Act  and  any  other
written law, the body corporate shall have the power to do,
perform and execute the following acts for the achievement
of the objects of the body corporate:-

(a)
subject to any restrictions whether now existing or
as  may  from  time  to  time  be  imposed  by  law,  to
purchase, buy, rent, take on lease or exchange, hire
or  otherwise,  acquire  any  movable  or  immovable
property  that  include  lands,  buildings,  vehicles,
equipment  and  machinery,  assets,  securities,
facilities and any rights licenses or privileges in Sri
Lanka or elsewhere and manage, improve, develop
and dispose of the same in whole or in part by virtue
of sell, mortgage, lease, exchange or otherwise for
the attainment of the objects of the body corporate
and  to  create  any  depreciation  fund,  reserve  or
sinking  funds  for  these  purposes  subject  to  the
discretion of the Committee of the body corporate:
Provided  that,  in  case  the  body  corporation
shall take or hold any property which may be subject
to  any  trusts,  the  body  corporate  shall  only  deal
with or invest the same in such manner as allowed
by law, having regard to such trust and in the case
of body corporate shall take or hold any property, it
shall not sell, mortgage, charge or lease the same
without  the  prior  written  authority,  approval  or
consent of the Registrar of Companies or without
the authority, approval or consent as may otherwise
be  required  by  law.  The  Committee  of  the  body
corporate  shall  be  chargeable,  answerable  and
accountable  for  their  acts,  receipts,  neglects  and
defaults with regard to such property;

(b)
to  erect,  construct,  enlarge,  develop,  alter  and
maintain any buildings, roads, plant, machinery and
any assets as may be necessary or convenient;
